evidence.quote: The Baden-Württemberg state government introduced tuition fees of €1500 / semester for non-EU students in Winter Semester 2017/18.

notes: The application deadline of 15 July is general and not specifically stated for international/non-EU applicants, so it is omitted. The fee is stated per semester (€1,500) for non-EU students, matching the programme page and the general fee document; it is not a year figure.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission et la procédure Smart Admission pour les candidats non-UE.
note.en: Check admission requirements and Smart Admission procedure for non-EU applicants.

evidence.quote: While most non-EU applicants are typically restricted from direct access to Bachelor’s studies, we offer a direct entry route to the International Engineering programme.
